high.label: High-end (12 GB+ VRAM)
high.why: 12 GB+ VRAM fits a 7.2 GB generator fully on the GPU.

mid.label: Mid-range (6-12 GB VRAM)
mid.why: 6-12 GB VRAM fits a 6.1 GB generator on the GPU.

cpu_rich.label: CPU-rich (16 GB+ RAM, < 6 GB VRAM)
cpu_rich.why: Plenty of RAM but the GPU is too small for a big model; a small fast generator on CPU beats a big one spilling.

low.label: Standard (8-16 GB RAM)
low.why: Limited RAM; a 2.5 GB generator is the safe fit.

minimal.label: Minimal (< 8 GB RAM, CPU-only)
minimal.why: Very low RAM; the smallest model is the only safe choice.
